name: Khao Thai Food - Bedok Market Place
description:
Khao (Thai Food) offers some of the best Thai cuisines, serving a wide selection of palatable dishes which they carefully prepared using only the freshest and most delicious ingredients, every dish in the menu is bound to satisfy your cravings and delight your taste buds. MUST TRIES: Treat yourself and indulge in satisfaction with their tantalizing collection of mouthwatering dishes such as Thai Fried Chicken Wing, Stir-Fry Kang Kong, Sambal Petai with Prawns, Glass Noodle Salad, Tom Yum Seafood Soup, Spam Fries and so much more! 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
